title: Lockout/Tagout Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Lockout/Tagout Job Safety Analysis template for manufacturing you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
standard: OSHA 29 Cfr 1910.147 - Control Of Hazardous Energy

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Notification & Shutdown-Incomplete communication
-Misunderstood scope		-Confusion
-Unexpected startup		6 (MEDIUM)-Notify all affected employees
-Explain scope of work
-Shut down equipment by normal means
-Identify all energy sources
2. Energy Isolation-Missed energy source
-Incomplete isolation		-Accidental startup
-Release of stored energy		25 (VERY HIGH)-Identify ALL energy sources
-Electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic
-Chemical, thermal, gravitational
-Stored energy (capacitors, springs, etc.)
3. Lock/Tag Application-Wrong lock
-Missing tag
-Multiple energy sources		-Inadequate protection
-Unintentional re-energize		20 (VERY HIGH)-Use group LOTO procedure
-Each worker applies own lock
-Tags must be legible and durable
-Verify all isolation points locked
4. Verification & Testing-No verification
-Improper test
-Forgotten stored energy		-Death/serious injury25 (VERY HIGH)-Attempt normal startup controls
-Use proper test equipment
-Verify zero energy state
-Check for stored energy
5. Removal & Restart-Premature removal
-Missing workers
-Left locks		-Injury to workers
-Equipment damage		15 (HIGH)-Inspect work area for tools/materials
-Ensure all guards are replaced
-Remove locks in reverse order
-Account for all workers
-Notify affected employees
